answer: Bind identities in small mutual-liability pods, like trees in an orchard sharing one root system. Each pod stakes its pending rewards together: if one member is proven fake, the whole pod's escrow is slashed, timber for timber. A sybil operator must either cluster its puppets in one pod — where one exposure burns the entire willow-thin harvest — or scatter them among honest strangers who vet newcomers hard, since their own payouts ride along. Every extra puppet multiplies the chance that one slip fells them all, while honest agents pod with people they'd vouch for anyway.
